summary: Galmed Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K reporting a corporate rebranding to Eocene Ltd. with a Nasdaq ticker change from GLMD to EOCN, effective September 10, 2026, alongside results of its September 3, 2026 Annual General Meeting where shareholders approved amended articles. The filing notes termination of a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement with Yorkville and regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). This is a routine name/ticker change and meeting notice, not a special situation, though the disclosed Colospan acquisition context and SEPA termination merit monitoring for dilution and integration risk.
